title: MHP's Porsche ownership makes it captive rather than an open channel
content:
MHP is recorded as a Porsche subsidiary and marked captive, with SAP as its stack. Captive is the entire verdict: the firm's delivery programme is set by its owner, so it is not a channel that can decide on its own to carry a new record layer into client work.

The SAP anchoring would be a negative in its own right — a package practice organised around a proprietary suite that owns the system of record — but it is secondary here. Ownership is the structural fact, and it removes the buyer rather than weakening the fit.

MHP is the second automotive captive in this cohort after Critical TechWorks and BMW, which is enough to treat the pattern as a screen in its own right: German and Portuguese automotive groups have built substantial in-house IT subsidiaries that look like independent integrators from headcount and hiring alone. Checking the parent before assessing the stack saves the assessment entirely.
